metadata.question: Did Punjab and Haryana have the most amount of active fire detections in 2016 compared to all other years from 2012 to 2024?

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Define Punjab and Haryana geometries
punjab = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[[73.8, 29.5], [76.9, 29.5], [76.9, 32.5], [73.8, 32.5], [73.8, 29.5]]])
haryana = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[[74.4, 27.6], [77.6, 27.6], [77.6, 30.9], [74.4, 30.9], [74.4, 27.6]]])
region = punjab.union(haryana)

# 2. Load MODIS Fire product (MCD14ML - Terra and Aqua combined)
# FIRMS data available through Earth Engine
fires = ee.ImageCollection('FIRMS').select('T21')

# Check if collection exists and has data
years_data = {}

for year in range(2012, 2025):
    start_date = f'{year}-01-01'
    end_date = f'{year}-12-31'
    
    year_fires = fires.filterDate(start_date, end_date).filterBounds(region)
    
    count = year_fires.size().getInfo()
    
    if count == 0:
        years_data[year] = 0
    else:
        # Count fire pixels in the region
        fire_count = year_fires.mosaic().reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry=region,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('T21')
        
        fire_val = fire_count.getInfo()
        years_data[year] = fire_val if fire_val is not None else 0

# Check if we got any data
if all(v == 0 for v in years_data.values()):
    print("No FIRMS data available. Trying MODIS MCD64A1 (Burned Area)...")
    
    # Fallback to burned area product
    burned = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD64A1').select('BurnDate')
    
    for year in range(2012, 2025):
        start_date = f'{year}-01-01'
        end_date = f'{year}-12-31'
        
        year_burned = burned.filterDate(start_date, end_date).filterBounds(region)
        
        if year_burned.size().getInfo() == 0:
            years_data[year] = 0
            continue
        
        # Count burned pixels
        burn_count = year_burned.map(lambda img: img.gt(0)).sum().reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
            geometry=region,
            scale=3000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('BurnDate')
        
        burn_val = burn_count.getInfo()
        years_data[year] = burn_val if burn_val is not None else 0

# Print results
print("Fire detections by year (Punjab & Haryana):")
for year in sorted(years_data.keys()):
    print(f"{year}: {years_data[year]}")

# Check if all years have zero or None
if all(v == 0 or v is None for v in years_data.values()):
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Find year with maximum fires
    max_year = max(years_data, key=lambda k: years_data[k] if years_data[k] is not None else 0)
    max_count = years_data[max_year]
    count_2016 = years_data[2016]
    
    print(f"\nMax fires: {max_count} in {max_year}")
    print(f"2016 fires: {count_2016}")
    
    if count_2016 is None or count_2016 == 0 and max_count > 0:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
    elif max_year == 2016 and count_2016 > 0:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
